title: TimeMagic
description: A simple data pack that allows you to freeze and unfreeze time by dropping a clock (Q)!
body:
## ⏳ Time Magic: Freeze Time!

Have you ever wanted to become the ultimate master of time in Minecraft? With this data pack, you can freeze and unfreeze time with a single button press, just like a superhero!

### 🕹️ How It Works

1. **Get the Item:** Grab a regular **Clock** (`minecraft:clock`) and hold it in your hand.
2. **Activate:** Press your drop key (Default: **Q**).
3. **The Magic:** The clock will briefly toss into the air, a magic sound will play, and **all mobs in the world will freeze completely on the spot!**
4. **Resume Time:** Want time to move again? Just press **Q** with the clock in your hand one more time.

### ✨ Key Features

* **Instant Return:** Don't worry about losing your item! The data pack automatically teleports the clock straight back into your inventory the exact millisecond you drop it.
* **Complete Freeze:** Creepers, zombies, animals, and other entities will stop dead in their tracks.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fully lightweight. No mods or heavy resource packs required—it runs purely on optimized Minecraft commands!

---
*Enjoy your new time-lord powers!*
